profiles.subject: Theotokos

overview.text: The OCA explains this title as referring to people in danger of spiritual death as well as bodily peril.
overview.reason: Necessary concise summary of the identified published account; its modern English prose is not reproduced in full.

blocks.text: The selected seventeenth-century image identifies the Seeker of the Perishing. Mary and the Child occupy the central composition, with small standing saints along its borders. Its date does not establish the origin of every wonderworking icon bearing the title.

blocks.text: The source explicitly says reliable accounts of the type’s origin are lacking. It recounts several separate wonderworking images, including Theodotos Obukhov’s rescue in a blizzard and a commissioned copy at Bor. It also follows a Moscow image damaged during the 1812 invasion. These are distinct traditions, not one securely documented object history.
